recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for current core FHIR. If legacy-version migration artifacts are reviewed later, evaluate them separately; no current ImagingStudy source fix is needed for FHIR-5811.
issue_request: FHIR-5811 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 FHIR-core ImagingStudy request to add a search parameter for the DiagnosticOrder/order references associated with an ImagingStudy.
initial_application: Git commit 217b178aefaf287e7db78ea1a2015d2c23dd9d71 explicitly applied ImagingStudy #5811 by adding an order reference search row on ImagingStudy.order to the old ImagingStudy spreadsheet source.
additional_context: FHIR-10349 later reached Published/Persuasive status and directed ImagingStudy.order to be renamed to ImagingStudy.basedOn while broadening it to plans, proposals, and requests. In the current active build, source/fhir.ini includes imagingstudy=ImagingStudy, ImagingStudy.basedOn is defined as the plan or order fulfilled by the study with ServiceRequest as a target, and bundle-ImagingStudy-search-params.xml defines a based-on reference search parameter over ImagingStudy.basedOn. Direct FHIR-5811 Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Reintroducing an obsolete order search code would conflict with the later Published workflow rename; the active based-on SearchParameter is the correct current representation of the FHIR-5811 capability.

related_jiras.note: Published ImagingStudy workflow issue that renamed the original order relationship to basedOn and determines the current spelling of the search capability.
